scripts.start: bash -c 'source .env.config && if [ -n "$N8N_COMMON_DOMAIN" ]; then open "https://$PROJECT_NAME.$N8N_COMMON_DOMAIN"; else open "https://$N8N_PROJECTS_DOMAIN"; fi'
scripts.edit-env: bash -c '[ ! -e .env ] || { echo ".env already exists: encrypt or remove it first, edit-env would overwrite it" >&2; exit 1; }; bash scripts/sops-env.sh --decrypt && "${EDITOR:-nano}" .env && bash scripts/sops-env.sh --encrypt'
scripts.test:unit: bash n8n/scripts/scan-workflow-secrets.test.sh && bash n8n/scripts/vps-runtime.test.sh && bash scripts/test-validate-config.sh && bash scripts/test-prompts.sh && bash scripts/test-check-prerequisites.sh && python3 scripts/test-prebilling.py && python3 scripts/test-refresh-image-pins.py && python3 scripts/test-wizard.py && python3 scripts/test-setup-docs.py && python3 scripts/generate-setup-docs.py --check && python3 scripts/test-initialized-instance.py
